_crawl.about: The integration of Malvern Panalytical, Micromeritics and SciAps creates a powerful combination of market-leading analytical technologies. We are the toolmakers for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories. More than 92,000 of our instruments are used daily in customers' laboratories worldwide. Customers value us for our analytical technologies and deep expertise—we are their partners in discovery. Malvern Panalytical instruments analyze the chemical, physical and structural nature of materials, from proteins to polymers and semiconductors to minerals. Our technologies measure particle size, shape, concentration and zeta potential, biomolecular interactions and stability, elemental concentrations and crystallographic structure. Micromeritics manufactures characterization systems for particles, powders, and porous materials across catalysts, chemicals, building materials, clean-tech and battery markets. Our technologies measure surface area, porosity, density, adsorption and particle activity. SciAps specializes in portable X-ray fluorescence (XRF), laser-based (LIBS) and near-infrared (NIR) analyzers to measure any element in any environment—our Center of Excellence for handheld instruments. We have a global footprint with R&D and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe, and Asia. Our 2,500+ employees operate in a customer-focused organization with sales and service offices in 20 countries, delivering expert and responsive support. We are committed to achieving Net Zero in operations by 2030, and across our total value chain by 2040. We are part of Spectris. Spectris combines precision with purpose, delivering progress for a more sustainable world. Our leading instruments and software equip customers to solve critical challenges, making the world cleaner, healthier and more productive.
